entities.summary: Woldemar Friedrich von Olivier was a German history painter in the Romantic style, often associated with the Nazarene movement. Friedrich von Olivier was a painters & sculptors from Dessau (1791-04-23, Dessau–1859-09-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
